paite: Aw hong pai TOUPA pahtawi in nuamsatak in la i sa ding uh; i hotdamna suangpi pahtawi in nuamsatak in i kikou ding uhi.
heading: Phatna La
english: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

paite: Kipahthu gen in ama ah pai ni e, phatna la sa a amah pahtawi in nuamsatak in aw i suah ding uhi.
english: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

paite: TOUPA Pathian athupi mahmah ziak in, pathian tengteng tung ah Kumpipa thupitak ahi.
english: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.

paite: Amah khut ah lei mun thuktakte a-om a, mual dawn sangtakte amah a mah ahi.
english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

paite: Tuipi amah a ahi a, ama bawl ahi a; gam leng akhutsuak ahi.
english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

paite: Aw hong pai unla, bia in kun ni e, TOUPA eite Hon siampa ma ah i khukdin ding uh.
english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,

paite: Amah i Pathian ahi a, eite agantatna mun a mite leh, akhut a belamte i hi ngal ua. Tuni in a-aw na zak uleh,
english: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

paite: Meribah a ahih bang un na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un, Gamdai a Massah ni bang in.
english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

paite: Huai lai in na pipute un ahon khem ua, hon ze-et ua, ka thilhih amu uhi.
english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

paite: Kum sawmli sung huai suante tung ah ka lunghi kei hi. Alungtang ua ngaihkhelh hatmi ahi ua, ka lampite leng athei kei uhi, ka chi hi.
english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

paite: Huaiziak in ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh, chi in heh in ka kichiam hi.
english: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
